cited_evidence: Behavioural criterion requires preserving record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
top_level_input for n06-r01 has source_weight 5, but job_downstream_coverage_priority input needs has n06-r01 source_weight 9.
top_level_input for n06-r08 has source_weight 2, but job_downstream_coverage_priority input needs has n06-r08 source_weight 3.
initial_receipt.explanation: The upstream demand handoff corrupted source_weight values by replacing them with demand_score values. Job 2 consumed those handoffs and otherwise preserved/map-ranked its supplied inputs, so the fault localizes to job 1. The supplied upstream code shows the exact responsible assignment in select_demand.
